The question: "Since when did the bun bang fai (rocket festival) start being held in southern Thailand?" (Thai)

The answer: The bun bang fai in southern Thailand is held at Tambon Phukhao Thong, Amphoe Sukhirin, Narathiwat Province. It started being organized since 1979 (พ.ศ. 2522), first held in the community at Ban Ai Pa Jo. There's a slight discrepancy: some sources say พ.ศ.2520 (Thai PBS says "จัดสืบทอดกันมาตั้งแต่ปี พ.ศ.2520"), while most sources (Matichon, Khaosod, MGR) say the first event was in 1979 (พ.ศ. 2522). The most common and specific answer: 2522 (1979).
